name: @asf/worker
description: Claims one role task, runs it via an AgentRuntime in an isolated worktree, reports events, exits.

scripts.test: sh -c 'ts=$(find src -name "*.test.ts"); mjs=$(find hooks -name "*.test.mjs"); [ -z "$ts$mjs" ] && echo "no tests" || node --test --import tsx --import ./test-setup.mjs $ts $mjs'
